# 两年做到年入350万，她的秘诀是：离客户近一点

**2023年8月。**

暑假。

大学还没开学。

Thao 和她的联合创始人看到了一堆"和你的PDF聊天"的应用。

挺有意思的。

但很快意识到：太局限了。

**人们处理的不只是PDF。**

还有 Word、网站、演示文稿、视频……

所以他们花了一个周末，

建了个叫 MindPal 的第一个版本。

**一个地方，扔所有文件——任何文件——然后和它们聊天。**

为什么这么快？

部分因为真的简单——

就一页应用加个支付网关。

部分因为之前的失败创业给的心态和技能。

**他们之前花了1.5年在另一个创业上。**

失败了。

为什么？

**完全脱离潜在客户。**

那次经历教会了他们无价的一课：

**最重要的是：建人们真正想要的产品。**

**没有客户服务，其他什么都不重要。**

产品上线 Product Hunt。

**Top 4 Product of the Day。**

接下来2-3周，约100个付费客户。

他们决定辍学，全职做 MindPal。

几个月后拿到美国 VC 的小笔 pre-seed。

但大部分花在基础设施和运营上。

MindPal 已经进化了。

现在是无代码平台。

面向企业主、创业者、营销人员、创作者、教练、顾问。

**帮他们建 AI agent 和多 agent 系统，自动化业务流程。**

**现在年营收50万美元。**

早期客户很快要求更多。

他们不只想和数据聊天；

想定制 AI 行为。

不同用户——比如营销人员 vs 研究人员——

需要 AI 基于特定目标不同回应。

他们也拿到了第一个 B2B 客户，

也需要这种定制。

2023年9月，想到自定义 AI agent 的点子。

MindPal 从聊天工具升级为平台。

用户可以建自己的定制 AI agent，

基于特定上下文和需求训练。

建产品过程中，

收到几个定制 AI 自动化系统开发的请求。

一个医疗公司需要自动化写医疗预约笔记，

涉及几个分析步骤。

一个商业教练想用特定教练框架自动评估商业想法。

他们意识到这些任务对单个 AI agent 太复杂。

**需要多个专业 agent 按顺序协作。**

这让他们想到多 agent 工作流。

2024年2月，把这个能力直接建进 MindPal。

让用户连接不同 AI 专业 agent 成链，

自动化更复杂的业务流程。

这个领域，AI 库和框架本身和创业公司一样新、一样实验性。

刚开始时，Langchain 后端、Vercel AI SDK 前端还在进化。

意味着不稳定、有隐藏 bug，

甚至没有确定的"正确方式"来构建 AI agent。

他们最初依赖这些框架快速启动；

但很快发现依赖创造了自身问题，

比如性能瓶颈和构建限制。

对于需要灵活性和控制来建自己 AI agent 的平台，

这不可持续。

**所以他们逐渐转变，减少对外部库的依赖，**

**建更多自己的核心基础设施。**

现在 MindPal 上所有 AI agent 和多 agent 工作流

都用他们自己的方式运行。

有自由基于自己的学习持续创新和迭代，

不用担心库的限制。

游戏在改变。

随着 Cursor 等强大 AI 编程助手的兴起，

纯技术障碍比以前感觉少多了。

现在更大的挑战——

真正重要的——

**是有愿景和品味去理解用户真正需要什么，**

**以及如何为他们建真正有价值的东西。**

怎么找客户？

**1. 客户推荐**

当用户成功在 MindPal 内设置 AI agent/多 agent 工作流，

产生实际价值并频繁使用时，

他们经常开始向创业者朋友谈论。

这种口碑营销带来高度相关的新用户。

为放大这种有机效应，

他们实施了联盟计划，20% 循环佣金，

在应用内建了多个分享功能。

**2. 社区建设（外部和自有）**

双管齐下的社区策略。

首先，和目标受众聚集的外部社区合作，

做演讲——关于如何整体 leverage AI 进业务，

以及特别如何使用 MindPal。

其次，建立和培育自己的社区。

MindPal Hub Facebook 群组，现在约3000成员。

不仅分享更新和用例，

更重要的是促进成员分享自己成功的实现和 AI 用例。

这种用户生成的证明让 MindPal 在潜在客户中保持 top of mind，

持续展示平台价值。

**3. 教育内容（YouTube 和博客）**

投资创建长篇教育内容。

关键是专注实用、可执行的建议，

围绕商业真实世界 AI 用例。

不只谈理论；

分享具体例子，经常提供模板，

用户可以直接复制和定制。

这让 MindPal 成为知识渊博的资源，

吸引积极寻找 AI 解决方案的用户，

通过给切实起点降低进入门槛。

**4. 免费工具（工程作为营销）**

开发和提供网站上的免费独立小工具，

比如免费 AI Agent Builder。

这些工具解决潜在客户可能在线搜索的特定、细分需求。

用户找到并使用免费工具，

获得即时价值，

然后被介绍给主 MindPal 平台的更广泛能力。

商业模式基于订阅。

不同计划——Individual、Team、Business——

基于使用因素：

AI 信用额度、知识数据存储量、用户座位数。

定价从每月49美元到449美元。

收入增长策略的核心是确保用户获得真正价值并留下。

**缩短新用户的价值实现时间：**

MindPal 是建东西的平台，

自然有点学习曲线。

持续跟踪和改进 onboarding，

让新用户更快建立和运行实际为他们工作的 AI agent（或多 agent 工作流）。

**确保现有客户持续稳定可靠地从 MindPal 获得价值：**

密切关注平台性能——

加载速度、AI 可靠性——

和客户使用分析。

需要确保已经有效的东西持续工作并变得更好，

所有付费客户实际上都在使用 MindPal 以支持健康的 MRR 增长。

大约每6个月尝试涨价，通常1.5倍到2倍。

只在产品显著改进、增加显著更多价值后才做。

最初担心会吓跑人，

但每次——从12美元（你能相信吗？！）到20美元，

现在49美元+——

**实际上吸引了更多客户。**

重要的是，仔细测试应用后才订阅的客户，

真正欣赏价值，长期更适合他们。

早期低价只带来不认真的人，

很快流失。

最大的三个优势：

**联合创始人 Tuan：**

诚实说，做过的最好决定是和 Tuan 一起开始 MindPal。

真的想象不出更好的联合创始人。

工作标准极高。

非常有野心，所以从不轻易满足——

即使达到里程碑，

他也很快指出各种改进机会。

这很棒，因为它提醒总有成长空间。

他的逻辑、第一性原理思维

帮她透过表面想法看到真正重要的，

或想出更好的做事方式。

**用 MindPal 本身来增长 MindPal：**

曾经考虑过雇更多人处理一些琐事，

这可能感觉像简单的出路。

但过度依赖招聘会让你懒得搞清楚

工作是否真的重要，

或者是否有更聪明的方式，也许用 AI。

他们开始在运营中密集使用 MindPal——

不只是写博客等简单事，

而是核心、重要的流程，

可以把知识和要求嵌入 AI agent 的地方。

这迫使他们清晰思考自己的流程并正确记录。

结果往往令人惊讶：

一致性无疑更好，

有时甚至质量提高，

因为 AI 能更快处理大量信息。

更重要的是，自己使用 MindPal

帮助他们在更深层面理解产品，

识别改进领域（更好地服务自己就是更好地服务客户），

发现和用户社区分享的新用例和可能性，

最终让客户更粘性，

因为他们看到更多获得价值的方式。

**系统思维：**

容易陷入日常琐事，

错过更大图景或更聪明的方法，

尤其是小团队。

系统思维帮助他们发现做事情的聪明方式，

提供指数级和可持续的结果，

比习惯的常规、默认方式好得多。

例如，不只是团队创建用例示例（很慢），

他们建了一个系统让社区建模板、分享、讨论。

这创造了被动、不断增长的新用例来源，

指数级快于他们独自能做的。

这适用于业务很多更多领域。

它迫使他们更深入、更有效地思考，

不只是对即时时刻反应。

基于这段旅程的一个建议：

**离你的客户近一点。**

她认为早期创业公司/业务失败的所有原因

都是某种形式的缺乏客户。

开始时，专注建他们真正需要并愿意付钱的东西。

其余只是噪音。

拿到客户后，其他东西你最终都会搞定的。

这是她想告诉过去的自己的。

未来愿景：

老实说，感觉真的只是触及 MindPal 能成为什么的表面，

还有这么多想做的工作。

坚信帮助人们为他们的业务启动自己定制 AI agent 团队的平台

随着 AI 模型每天都在变好，总是需要的。

因为无论 AI 模型变得多好，

它们仍然不了解特定业务、

它的目标、它的策略、它的流程，

以及人类专业知识和品味。

但他们知道还有两个大事在积极努力：

**让构建过程快10倍：**

现在可能需要几个小时让人真正理解 MindPal

并为他们的特定业务建真正有价值的东西。

目标是把时间缩短到几分钟。

想让它如此简单直观，

绝对任何人都能用最少的学习和不需要太多外部帮助

建自己的 AI agent 大军。

建定制 AI agent 成为无脑选择，

因为花很少时间获得这么多价值。

**让定制 AI agent 开箱即用：**

不只是让人们定制 agent。

想让这些 agent 对特定业务真正有效和有用，

几乎立即，理解你的上下文和需求，

不需要大量调整。

随着 AI 变好，

它将处理业务中越来越多的日常执行，

让事情更便宜更快。

当那发生时，什么变得更有价值？

人的元素——

战略、创意想法、细微品味、独特洞察。

想让 MindPal 帮助加速那个未来。

基本上，如果 AI 能有效做某事，让它做。

人类时间和大脑太珍贵，

不能花在机器能处理的任务上。

有些人担心 AI 抢工作，

但他们不这么看——

他们认为这没抓住重点。

就像历史上每个其他重大技术转变一样，

旧的或过时的任务被取代，

解放人们去做新类型的工作、更雄心勃勃的项目、更大的梦想。

想想看——

对人类还有这么多巨大挑战和机会，

比如真正探索太空、理解宇宙、

治愈癌症等疾病、搞清量子计算，等等。

如果我们能自动化平凡的任务，

想象一下这给我们的自由——

时间、精力、心理空间，

专注于那些更大、更重要的事情。

他们真的很兴奋能帮助实现和加速那个转变。

说实话，这个故事最打动我的是什么？

不是50万美元 ARR。

**是那句："我们之前花了1.5年在另一个创业上。失败了。"**

**"完全脱离潜在客户。"**

多少人第一次创业就成功？

很少。

但 Thao 证明了：

**失败不是终点。**

**是教训。**

**是你下一次成功的基石。**

你呢？

你失败过吗？

你还在舔伤口，

还是已经站起来了？

content_en:
Her secret to achieving an annual income of 3.5 million yuan in two years is to stay closer to customers

August 2023.

Summer vacation.

College hasn't started yet.

Thao and her co-founder saw a bunch of "chat with your PDF" apps.

It was fun.

But I quickly realized that it was too limited.

People are dealing with more than just PDFs.

There are also Word, websites, presentations, videos...

So they spent the weekend,

Created the first version called MindPal.

In one place, throw all files-any file-and chat with them.

Why so fast?

Partly because it's really simple--

Add a payment gateway for one page of application.

Partly because of the mentality and skills given by previous failed entrepreneurship.

They had previously spent 1.5 years working on another venture.

Failed.

Why?

Completely divorced from potential customers.

That experience taught them a priceless lesson:

The most important thing is to build products that people really want.

Without customer service, nothing else matters.

Product launch Product Hunt.

Top 4 Product of the Day。

In the next 2-3 weeks, about 100 paying customers.

They decided to drop out of school and work full-time on MindPal.

A few months later, I got a small pre-seed from American VC.

But most of it is spent on infrastructure and operations.

MindPal has evolved.

Now there is a code-less platform.

For business owners, entrepreneurs, marketers, creators, coaches, consultants.

Help them build AI agent and multi-agent systems to automate business processes.

Annual revenue is now $500,000.

Early customers quickly demand more.

They don't just want to chat with data;

Want to customize AI behavior.

Different users--marketers versus researchers--

AI needs to respond differently based on specific goals.

They also got their first B customer,

This customization is also needed.

In September 2023, I came up with the idea of customizing an AI agent.

MindPal upgraded from a chat tool to a platform.

Users can build their own customized AI agents,

Training based on specific contexts and needs.

During product building,

Received several requests for customized AI automation system development.

A medical company needs to automate taking notes on medical appointments,

There are several analytical steps involved.

A business coach wants to automatically evaluate business ideas using a specific coaching framework.

They realized that these tasks were too complex for a single AI agent.

Multiple professional agents are required to collaborate in sequence.

This made them think of multi-agent workflows.

In February 2024, this capability will be built directly into MindPal.

Allow users to connect different AI professional agents into a chain,

Automate more complex business processes.

In this area, AI libraries and frameworks themselves are as new and experimental as startups.

At the beginning, the Langchain backend and the Vercel AI SDK front-end were still evolving.

Means instability, hidden bugs,

There is not even a definite "right way" to build AI agents.

They initially relied on these frameworks to get started quickly;

But soon discovered that dependence created its own problems,

Such as performance bottlenecks and build constraints.

For platforms that require flexibility and control to build their own AI agents,

This is not sustainable.

So they gradually shifted and reduced their reliance on external repositories.

Build more of your own core infrastructure.

Now all AI agent and multi-agent workflows on MindPal

all operate in their own way.

Have the freedom to continue to innovate and iterate based on your own learning,

Don't worry about library limitations.

The game is changing.

With the rise of powerful AI programming assistants such as Cursor,

Pure technical obstacles feel much less than before.

Now the bigger challenge--

What really matters--

Is there a vision and taste to understand what users really need,

and how to build something truly valuable for them.

How to find customers?

1. customer recommendation

When the user successfully sets up the AI agent/multi-agent workflow in MindPal,

When generating real value and using it frequently,

They often start talking to their entrepreneur friends.

This kind of word-of-mouth marketing brings in highly relevant new users.

To amplify this organic effect,

They implemented an alliance plan with a 20% recurring commission,

Multiple sharing functions are built into the application.

2. Community building (external and own)

A two-pronged community strategy.

First, work with external communities where the target audience gathers to

Give a speech-on how to integrate leverage AI into the business as a whole,

and how to use MindPal in particular.

Second, build and cultivate your own community.

The MindPal Hub Facebook group now has approximately 3000 members.

Not only share updates and use cases,

What's more important is to encourage members to share their successful implementations and AI use cases.

This generated certificate allows Pal to remain top of mind among potential customers,

Continue to demonstrate the value of the platform.

3. Educational content (YouTube and blogs)

Invest in creating long educational content.

The key is to focus on practical, actionable advice,

Focus on commercial real-world AI use cases.

Not just theory;

Share specific examples, often provide templates,

Users can directly copy and customize it.

This makes MindPal a knowledgeable resource,

Attract users who are actively looking for AI solutions,

Lower barriers to entry by giving a practical starting point.

4. Free tool (engineering as marketing)

Develop and provide free standalone widgets on the website to

For example, free AI Agent Builder.

These tools address specific, segmented needs that potential customers may search online.

Users find and use free tools to

Get instant value,

It was then introduced to the broader capabilities of the main MindPal platform.

The business model is based on subscriptions.

Different plans--Individual, Team, Business--

Based on usage factors:

AI credit limit, knowledge data storage capacity, user seat number.

Pricing ranges from $49 to $449 per month.

The core of a revenue growth strategy is to ensure that users get real value and stay.

Shorten value realization time for new users:

MindPal is a platform for building things,

Naturally, there is a learning curve.

Continuously track and improve onboarding,

Let new users build and run AI agents (or multi-agent workflows) that actually work for them faster.

Ensure that existing customers continue to gain value from MindPal stably and reliably:

Pay close attention to platform performance--

Loading speed, AI reliability--

and customer usage analysis.

Need to ensure that what already works continues to work and gets better,

Virtually all paying customers are using MindPal to support healthy MRR growth.

Try raising prices about every 6 months, usually 1.5 to 2 times.

Only do it after the product has significantly improved and added significantly more value.

Initially worried that it would scare people away,

But every time-from $12 (can you believe it?!) To $20,

Now $49 +--

It actually attracted more customers.

Importantly, customers who subscribe after carefully testing the app

Really appreciating the value is more suitable for them in the long run.

Early low prices only brought people who were not serious,

It was quickly lost.

The three biggest advantages:

Co-founder Tuan:

To be honest, the best decision I ever made was to start MindPal with Tuan.

I really can't imagine a better co-founder.

The working standards are extremely high.

Very ambitious, so he is never satisfied easily--

Even if milestones are reached,

He was also quick to point out opportunities for improvement.

This is great because it reminds us that there is always room for growth.

His logical, first-principles thinking

Help her see beyond the surface what's really important,

Or come up with a better way to do things.

Use MindPal itself to grow MindPal:

Having considered hiring more people to handle trivial matters,

This may feel like a simple way out.

But relying too much on job fairs makes you too lazy to figure it out

Whether work is really important,

Or whether there is a smarter way, maybe with AI.

They began to use MindPal intensively in operations--

Not just for simple things like blogging,

It is the core and important process,

A place where knowledge and requirements can be embedded into AI agents.

This forces them to think clearly about their processes and record them correctly.

The results are often surprising:

Consistency is undoubtedly better,

Sometimes even quality improves,

Because AI can process large amounts of information faster.

More importantly, use MindPal yourself

Help them understand the product at a deeper level,

Identify areas for improvement (serving yourself better is serving your customers better),

Discover new use cases and possibilities shared with the user community,

Eventually making customers more sticky,

Because they see more ways to gain value.

Systems thinking:

Easy to get caught up in daily chores,

Missing the bigger picture or smarter approach,

Especially small teams.

Systems thinking helps them discover smart ways to do things,

Provide exponential and sustainable results,

Much better than the usual, default way.

For example, not just the team creating use case examples (which are slow),

They built a system for the community to create templates, share, and discuss.

This creates a passive, growing source of new use cases that

Exponential faster than they could do alone.

This applies to many more areas of business.

It forces them to think deeper and more effectively,

Not just responding to immediate moments.

One suggestion based on this journey:

Stay closer to your customers.

She believes that all the reasons why early startups/businesses failed

It's all about some form of lack of customers.

Start by focusing on building what they really need and are willing to pay for.

The rest is just noise.

After you get the customer, you will eventually get everything else done.

This is what she wanted to tell her past self.

Future Vision:

To be honest, it really just feels like scratching the surface of what MindPal can be,

There is so much work I want to do.

Firmly believe in a platform that helps people launch their own customized AI agent teams for their businesses

As AI models get better every day, there is always a need.

Because no matter how good the AI model becomes,

They still don't understand specific businesses,

Its goals, its strategies, its processes,

as well as human expertise and taste.

But they know there are still two major things they are actively working on:

Make the build process 10 times faster:

It may take hours now for people to truly understand MindPal

and build something truly valuable for their specific business.

The goal is to shorten the time to a few minutes.

Want it to be so simple and intuitive,

Absolutely anyone can do it with minimal learning and without much external help

Build your own army of AI agents.

Building customized AI agents has become a brainless choice,

Because it takes so little time to gain so much value.
